newsitem.title: USA: Alberto-Culver votes 100 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Alberto-Culver votes 100 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Alberto-Culver Co said Thursday its board voted a 100 percent stock dividend. Earlier, the company said it voted to increase the quarterly dividend by 11.1 percent to $0.10 a share from $0.09.

One share of Class A common stock will be distributed for each share of Class A common held and one share of Class B common will be distributed for each Class B share held on February 20, record February 3.
Following the stock dividend, the new dividend rate per share will be $0.05 a share per quarter on a post-split basis.
About 22.4 million shares of Class A common will be outstanding following the stock dividend distribution, excluding treasury shares, and about 33.5 million Class B shares.
Alberto-Culver manufactures and markets personal care products.
